title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本の攻め筋

intro.ja:
中央の位を取ったら銀を前へ繰り出し、飛車・銀・歩で5筋を攻める。片美濃に玉を入れてから中央突破を目指す。5筋の歩を交換できるか、銀が前へ出た後に角頭が弱くならないかを見る。

角交換は中央へ持ち角を投入する手段にもなる。敵陣への角打ちで5筋の利きを増やし、相手の守りを上回る駒数を集める。角を交換しただけで攻めが成立するわけではなく、相手の角打ちと飛車の退路も読む。
intro.en:
After claiming central space, bring a silver forward so rook, silver, and pawn can cooperate on the fifth file. Half Mino gives the king shelter before committing to a breakthrough. Evaluate whether the central pawn can be exchanged and whether the silver’s departure leaves your bishop head vulnerable; attacking development must still preserve the camp’s essential defenses.

Bishop exchange can supply a bishop in hand that reinforces the central attack from a suitable drop square. Count attackers and defenders on the intended breakthrough rather than assuming the exchange itself creates an advantage. Also calculate the opponent’s bishop drops and your rook’s retreat: an active central rook can become trapped if the supporting pieces move too far ahead.

question.ja: 中央突破で数えるべきものは？
question.en: What should be counted before a central breakthrough?

answer.ja: 突破点に利く攻め駒と守り駒、交換後の持ち角の働き。
answer.en: Attackers and defenders on the target square, including the bishops in hand after exchanges.

courses.title: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本の攻め筋: 図1-1 ゴキゲン中飛車の基本図 → 図2-6 これでゴキゲン中飛車が勝勢
courses.titleEn: Central Rook attacking ideas: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Gokigen Central Rook → Figure 2-6: Now Gokigen Central Rook is winning
courses.goalFormation:
図2-6 これでゴキゲン中飛車が勝勢
相手が飛車を逃がしたら、△5七銀成と攻めて後手勝勢です。次に▲3九飛と角を取れば△5八成銀と攻めが続き、角を取らず▲5七銀と来れば△同角成で攻めが続きます。これで相手の陣形はボロボロです。

child.comment:
図2-6 これでゴキゲン中飛車が勝勢
相手が飛車を逃がしたら、△5七銀成と攻めて後手勝勢です。次に▲3九飛と角を取れば△5八成銀と攻めが続き、角を取らず▲5七銀と来れば△同角成で攻めが続きます。これで相手の陣形はボロボロです。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-6: Now Gokigen Central Rook is winning
Once the opponent moves the rook away, △5七銀成 puts White in a winning position. If Black then captures the bishop with ▲3九飛, the attack continues with △5八成銀, and if Black instead plays ▲5七銀 without taking the bishop, △同角成 keeps the attack going. Black's formation is in tatters.

section.ja: 中央に駒を足す角打ち
section.en: A bishop drop that adds a piece to the center

child.comment:
図2-5 飛車取りに当てながら攻め駒を足す
ここは△3九角と打つのが好手です。飛車取りに当てながら、5七の地点に攻め駒を足せます。相手が▲5六歩と銀を取っても、△2八角成で飛車が取れます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-5: Attack while adding pieces and hitting the rook
Dropping the bishop with △3九角 is the good move here. It attacks the rook while adding an attacking piece toward 5七. Even if the opponent captures the silver with ▲5六歩, △2八角成 wins the rook.

section.ja: 中央に駒を足す角打ち
section.en: A bishop drop that adds a piece to the center

child.comment:
図2-4 これで攻めがないようだが…？
角を交換したら、△5六銀から攻めます。相手に▲5七歩と打たれると攻めが続かないように見えますが、ここで先ほど取った角を使う手筋があります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-4: It seems there is no attack, but...?
After the bishop exchange, attack with △5六銀. It may look like the attack stalls if the opponent drops a pawn with ▲5七歩, but there is a tesuji using the bishop you just captured.

section.ja: 角を交換して持ち駒にしよう!
section.en: Exchange bishops and make it a piece in hand!

child.comment:
図2-3 まずは角交換
図2-2からは△5六銀と攻めたいところですが、まず角を交換します。ゴキゲン中飛車は5筋の歩を突いた時点で自分の角道が開くので、角を交換して持ち駒にすれば攻め駒を増やせます。また▲同玉と角を取らせることで、相手の守りの陣形を乱せるのもポイントです。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-3: First, exchange bishops
From this position you would like to attack with △5六銀, but first exchange bishops. In Gokigen Central Rook your bishop line opens once the fifth-file pawn is pushed, so exchanging bishops gives you a bishop in hand and more attacking pieces. Forcing the opponent to recapture with ▲同玉 also disrupts their defensive formation.

section.ja: 角を交換して持ち駒にしよう!
section.en: Exchange bishops and make it a piece in hand!

child.comment:
図2-2 中央から仕掛ける
いよいよ5筋から仕掛けます。まず△5六歩と5筋の歩を突き捨てます。ここで△7六銀と歩を取りに行く手も有力です。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-2: Attack from the center
Now the attack on the fifth file begins. First sacrifice the fifth-file pawn with △5六歩. Capturing the pawn with △7六銀 is also a good option here.

section.en: Aim to break through the center

child.comment:
図2-1 銀をさらに前に出す
中央を攻めるため、さらに銀を前に出しました。これで5六の地点に駒の利きが増えます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: Advance the silver further
To attack in the center, the silver is advanced further, which adds support to the 5六 square.

section.en: Aim to break through the center

child.comment:
図1-3 銀を中央に使っていく
囲いができたら、次は攻めの形を作ります。銀を中央に使うのがゴキゲン中飛車の基本の形で、ここから飛車と銀で攻めていきます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-3: Use the silver in the center
Once the castle is built, the next step is to build the attacking formation. Using the silver in the center is the basic shape of Gokigen Central Rook, and from here you attack with the rook and silver.

section.ja: 銀を中央に繰り出していく
section.en: Bring the silver out to the center

child.comment:
図1-2 片美濃囲いに組むのが基本
ゴキゲン中飛車側は、まず片美濃囲いを組むのが基本です。中飛車では5二に飛車がいて左の金を美濃囲いに寄せられないため、いったんこれで囲いは完成です。左の金は、△3二金として相手の飛車の攻めを守るのに使うこともあれば、△5一金と強引に囲いに寄せる手もあります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: Building Single Mino is basic
The Central Rook side basically begins by building the half Mino castle. With the rook on 5二, the left gold cannot join the Mino castle, so for now the castle is complete. The left gold can be used for defense against the opponent's rook with △3二金, or forced toward the castle with △5一金.

root.comment:
図1-1 ゴキゲン中飛車の基本図
図1-1はゴキゲン中飛車の基本図です。ゴキゲン中飛車は基本的に後手番で使う戦法なので、後手の立場から解説し、盤面を反転しています。基本形までの指し手や変化は別の記事で解説しています。
root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Gokigen Central Rook
This first diagram is the basic Gokigen Central Rook position. Since the opening is normally played as White, it is explained from White's side and the board is flipped. The moves and variations leading to the basic form are covered in another article.

section.en: Basic form of Gokigen Central Rook
